unit_budget.retry_rule: Retries remain inside the originating atomic task cap.

variables.N: The exact materialized candidate count in the frozen approved manifest.
variables.P: The exact count of promote dispositions; 0 <= P <= N. Each promote child owns its approved maximum sixteen-hour lifecycle UnitBudget instead of a caller estimate.

execute.derivation: Seven required parent research/terminal tasks, one preflight task, one active-index publication task, one local task for each non-promote candidate, and one complete sixteen-hour child UnitBudget for each promote candidate.

variables.N_i: Exact candidate count from attempt i's fresh audit.
variables.P_i: Exact promote count for attempt i after applying the approved rolling policy.

execute-rolling.derivation: Seven required parent research/terminal tasks once; each attempt reserves audit, preflight, active-index/checkpoint, and stable post-audit tasks, local non-promote tasks, and complete promotion child budgets.

drive.derivation: Seven required parent tasks, one complete eight-hour typed current-bundle verification child, and the live rolling productive attempt sum.

unit_budget.reservation_rule: Before each command or rolling attempt, the owner freezes and hashes the authoritative candidate manifest, computes the numeric UnitBudget from its exact N/P values, and reserves every launchable task/child. Candidate arrival invalidates that attempt; the parent remains STARTED, performs a fresh audit, computes a new complete attempt budget, and may pause before launch. Callers cannot supply counts, budgets, or max_attempts.

trusted_roots.disposition-approval-store: The durable approval store for exact content-addressed reconciliation manifests and rolling policies

parameter_contract.validation_boundary: Resolve and validate all files under trusted roots; require exact manifest-v3 fields, current repository HEAD, candidate set/order/content hashes, registry hash, candidate identities, dispositions, frozen registered target bundle hashes, promotion metadata, and separate approval receipt before budget reservation. Reject caller-controlled root, active index, policy, attempt count, budget variables, or qualification limits.

disposition_approval_contract.admission: Execute consumes an exact, unconsumed receipt matching the fully normalized manifest. An inline mutable approval object alone is insufficient. Rolling modes use the separately content-addressed checked-in approved policy and may only retain newly arrived remain-discovery candidates.
disposition_approval_contract.consumption: Bind receipt consumption atomically to execute effect preparation; identical replay by the same effect id is allowed.

audit.effect_identity: repository HEAD plus candidate path/set/content hashes plus registry hash plus output path
audit.reconciliation: Recompute the complete snapshot. An exact output manifest is ALREADY_APPLIED; no output is NOT_APPLIED; an existing different output or snapshot disagreement is INDETERMINATE.

validate.effect_identity: manifest canonical hash plus current repository/candidate/registry hashes
validate.reconciliation: Replay complete schema, snapshot, disposition, target bundle, and approval checks; return typed validity without mutation.

execute.effect_identity: approval receipt id plus manifest hash plus repository/candidate/registry snapshot plus fixed active-index target
execute.prepare: Persist and consume the approval receipt, numeric N/P UnitBudget, deterministic per-candidate child ids, expected checkpoint path/content progression, original discovery hashes, and expected active-index bytes before the first candidate.

candidate_reconciliation.promote: Require the approved discovery-promotion-lifecycle child terminal artifact and matching registered target bundle/same-path verification. Exact proof is ALREADY_APPLIED; no child evidence is NOT_APPLIED; partial or conflicting promotion evidence is INDETERMINATE.
candidate_reconciliation.absorb/supersede/already-promoted: Re-observe the exact frozen target bundle and current same-path registered verification. Matching checkpoint evidence is ALREADY_APPLIED; absent checkpoint with unchanged proof is NOT_APPLIED; proof drift is INDETERMINATE.
candidate_reconciliation.remain-discovery/quarantine: Require the original discovery bytes and deterministic retained checkpoint row; exact row is ALREADY_APPLIED, absence is NOT_APPLIED, and discovery drift is INDETERMINATE.

execute.resume_rule: Resume from the first candidate lacking exact semantic proof/checkpoint. A checkpoint alone cannot override missing child proof, and child proof after a crash prevents duplicate promotion.

execute-rolling.effect_identity: parent effect id plus approved policy hash plus fixed active-index target plus deterministic attempt ids 1..6
execute-rolling.prepare: Use effect-derived attempt directories rather than random UUIDs. For each attempt, persist the fresh audit hash, applied policy rows, N/P numeric budget, child ids, checkpoint target, and expected active-index bytes before execution.
execute-rolling.reconciliation: Reconcile each attempt through its audit, candidate child proofs/checkpoint, active index, and stable post-audit. Candidate-set arrival with no semantic decision change closes that attempt as superseded-by-next-attempt; changed existing disposition, non-retain arrival, target drift, or allowlist drift is INDETERMINATE and stops.
execute-rolling.attempt_rule: At most six deterministic attempts; never create a new invocation directory or repeat an already proved candidate effect after a crash.

drive.effect_identity: task id plus current registered bundle hash plus approved policy hash plus fixed output/active-index identities
drive.prepare: Persist deterministic current-bundle verification and live-rolling child ids, run ids, source bundle hash, and output paths before either child starts.
drive.reconciliation: The current-bundle child is ALREADY_APPLIED only with a passed-and-closed same-path receipt for the exact bundle. The live child is ALREADY_APPLIED only with a successful rolling terminal artifact plus matching live verification event and passed run closure. Resume the first absent child; conflicts or open blockers are INDETERMINATE.

common: The process return code is zero.
The output validates against the command-specific non-secret schema and has ok=true.
The semantic verifier reloads repository, candidate, registry, policy, manifest, checkpoint, child, ledger, and active-index evidence applicable to the command.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id.

command_specific.audit: The written manifest exactly matches a fresh complete audit snapshot; reported head/count/disposition counts match canonical manifest content.
command_specific.validate: The manifest and separate approval receipt match the current exact snapshot and every disposition/target proof; reported manifest_hash is canonical.
command_specific.execute: Every manifest candidate has one semantically proved checkpoint result; every promote child is registered and same-path verified; frozen targets have not drifted; the active index omits only evidence-backed terminal rows; original discovery provenance remains preserved.
command_specific.execute-rolling: One deterministic attempt at or before six has stable equal pre/post snapshots under the approved retain-only policy, complete candidate proofs/checkpoint, exact allowlist, and the canonical active index; earlier arrival-race attempts are durably superseded.
command_specific.drive: The current registered bundle has a passed-and-closed same-path child verification; the separate live rolling run satisfies execute-rolling terminal proof; its verification event and passed closure match the live run; stage is complete.

source_corrections: Replace caller root, active-index, baseline, output, max-attempt, and promotion-limit authority with fixed/trusted materialized fields.
Compute numeric UnitBudgets from each frozen candidate manifest and compose complete approved lifecycle child budgets; do not treat an arbitrary candidate loop as one invocation budget.
Replace random rolling invocation directories and fresh retry run ids with deterministic effect/attempt/child identities and journaled checkpoints.
Dispatch promotions and current-bundle verification through typed child contracts and require semantic child receipts before checkpoint or ledger verification.
Require a separate content-addressed disposition approval receipt and exactly one terminal artifact after full state re-observation.
